verdict.rationale: Docusign's eSignature product offers reusable/shareable templates, configurable workflows, delegated signing, real-time commenting, and identity verification — all generically applicable to preparing board consents/resolutions and routing them for approval online, and community evidence confirms it's used for binding legal transactions (house purchases, stock options). However, there is no evidence of board-consent/resolution-specific templates or governance workflows tailored to corporate secretary use cases. Missing for 10: purpose-built board-resolution/consent templates, cap-table or governance-specific approval routing, and independent case studies of legal-ops teams using it for board consents specifically.
